method.exclusive_categories: Each sample assigned exactly once, priority rollback > _collect > any nand_core.py ancestor > memory_transfer.py ancestor > deepest hbf_staging.py > deepest data_motion.py > other. method.inclusive_hotspots: Each distinct file/function counted at most once per sample. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed; line rows also overlap.

method.sample_time: Fixed 0.01-second weights. Sampled CPU call-stack residency, not exact function elapsed timers; py-spy attachment overhead is not separated.
